tools.name: worker_catalog
tools.description: Query approved models, runtime contract fingerprint and capabilities; no inference.

tools.name: worker_start
tools.description: Accept one scoped task durably; never wait for the first model token.

tools.name: worker_status
tools.description: Read one job or a stable recent-job snapshot. No prompt dispatch.

tools.name: worker_wait
tools.description: Wait up to 25 seconds without holding a mutation lock. Expiry never cancels the job.

tools.name: worker_result
tools.description: Page through immutable exported results; private raw output is not exposed.

tools.name: worker_followup
tools.description: Continue/retry explicitly; select_model requires a waiting-model state and user decision.

tools.name: worker_cancel
tools.description: Request interruption of the exact recorded attempt; confirm backend stop separately.

tools.name: worker_approve
tools.description: Deliver a scoped, authenticated approval decision. A challenge is not proof of human consent.
